title: Runtime Invocation
description: A runtime invocation is a distinct concept from a static node definition (Decision 1, design.md). It is an execution instance that references a definition by node_id. A single definition MAY correspond to many invocations in one run (a loop firing 7 times => 7 invocation records, one definition). Kept separate so node count stays per-definition and the graph stays diffable.

invocation_id.description: Unique id for this single execution instance. High-cardinality: a span attribute / relational column, NEVER a TSDB series label (NFR4).

node_id.description: References the static definition's node_id in the Workflow IR.

run_id.description: Groups all invocations of one execution batch. High-cardinality; not a TSDB series label.

invocation_index.description: 0-based index of this invocation among the definition's invocations within the run (e.g. 0..6 for a loop that fired 7 times).
